criteria.criterion: Desktop/q3_spend_audit.md reports the exact total Q3 software spend and per-department spend totals matching input/Desktop/q3_software_spend.csv.
criteria.expected: Total Q3 spend = $68,700; Engineering = $32,100, Infrastructure = $15,000, Marketing = $10,500, Product = $8,400, Operations = $2,700.
criteria.reason: Direct arithmetic requirement from the user prompt verifiable from the source CSV.

criteria.criterion: Desktop/q3_spend_audit.md flags INV-302 ($19,500) and INV-304 ($10,500) as non-compliant vendors exceeding $10,000 without VP sign-off.
criteria.expected: Both INV-302 (VectorStore Cloud, Engineering) and INV-304 (AdPulse Analytics, Marketing) are listed as policy violations.
criteria.reason: Core threshold rule in budget_policy.md rule 1.

criteria.criterion: Desktop/q3_spend_audit.md applies the Annual Continuity Waiver exception so INV-305 (DataVault Backup) is not classified as a policy violation.
criteria.expected: INV-305 ($15,000, preapproved_exception=yes) is excluded from violations and not mixed with non-compliant items; INV-301, INV-303, INV-306 are also compliant.
criteria.reason: Policy rule 2 explicitly exempts preapproved_exception=yes; anchor feedback highlighted this exact failure mode.

criteria.criterion: Desktop/q3_spend_audit.md reports the exact net non-compliant dollar total after excluding pre-approved exceptions.
criteria.reason: Explicit prompt deliverable #3 derived from true violations only.

criteria.criterion: Desktop/q3_spend_audit.md provides concise remediation actions per owner naming the invoice ID, department, and retroactive approval or downgrade action for each true violation.
criteria.expected: Actionable remediation items for Engineering (INV-302) and Marketing (INV-304), without demanding remediation for exempt INV-305.
criteria.reason: Explicit prompt deliverable #4 and policy rule 4.

limitations: Only verifies the requested Markdown audit report; does not prescribe a specific prose template or table layout.
